roles.name: mother
roles.when_to_use: Talks to the dev: runs the discovery, opens the feature, answers or escalates the questions of the squad and delivers the feature.

roles.name: leader
roles.when_to_use: Breaks the feature into tickets, hands each one to a worker and integrates the approved ones in the branch of the feature.

roles.name: worker
roles.when_to_use: Implements one ticket at a time in a branch of its own and sends the result to the judge.

roles.name: judge
roles.when_to_use: Evaluates the commit of each result against the criteria of its ticket and sends the verdict to the leader.
